family.description: The font family. Falls back to Ghostty's first `font-family`.

features.description:
OpenType features in Ghostty's `font-feature` syntax, such as `-calt` or `ss01`; replaces
Ghostty's list, and `[]` turns them all off.

size.description: The font size in points. Falls back to Ghostty's `font-size`.

symbols-family.description:
The face for private-use icons; unset tries Ghostty's other `font-family` lines, then
the main font.

command.description: The command to run through the launch shell; omit to open the shell itself.

description: The `config.toml` format. Every key is optional.

font.description: The terminal font. Each key falls back to Ghostty's config.

jump-command.description:
A command such as `j` or `zoxide query` that the command centre runs through `shell`
with the query to find a folder to open as a project.

shell.description: The shell new tabs run, as an absolute path.

tabs.description: The tabs a new project opens with.

theme.description:
A Ghostty theme name or absolute path; `light:X,dark:Y` picks the dark one.
Falls back to Ghostty's theme.

title: File
